name: Tejate
description: A cold pre-Hispanic drink of maize, cacao and mamey seed with a foam on top.

tcm.note: Outside the classical record; a cold maize and cacao drink; no classical entry.

ayurveda.note: Outside the classical record; cacao is ushna.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; thanda in practice.

histamine.note: Cacao is a fermented bean, and the maize is fermented too.
